notes.title: Sniper Killer - The Bonus Missions Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 



The Bonus Missions update is finally here! Thank you all for being so patient, we're excited to see people get a chance to play these new levels. We'll continue to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the Steam Discussion Forums or in the Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.



TRAILER: 
[previewyoutube="HRZtOutMXPU;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]
Patch Notes


Bonus Missions!






There are 6 Bonus Missions to Unlock, accessible from the main menu.

You can unlock each bonus mission by finding a Golden Bullet in one of the chapters of the main game. Chapters with a Golden Bullet to find in them are marked with a Bullet Silhouette in the Chapters select screen. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44048253/67a0d7d55bc48e33e488b4e2c4d67ff323c562eb.png"]



We hope you enjoy the Bonus Missions and the challenges they pose. Good Luck!

If you haven't already, please leave a review for the game, it helps a ton!



- Henry and Jordan

notes.title: Sniper Killer v1.04
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We're back with a big new update focused on optimization and performance improvements!
We'll of course continue to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the Steam Discussion Forums or in the Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.


[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes


Optimization: 

 Added "Only Render Scope Camera when in ADS" toggle under "Game" category in Options menu.

This option disables the main player camera while aiming down the sniper scope, significantly improving performance. 

 Decreased number of objects in all scenes
 Decreased number of fog renderers in scenes with fog



We've found that this generally results in a 10-15 FPS increase in all outdoor scenes, with an additional 10-15 FPS increase with the new option toggled on when relevant. 

We're still working on more bug fixes while we get the content update ready as well!

Thank you all for playing, and if you haven't already, please leave a review! It helps small indies like us a lot. 


- Henry and Jordan

notes.title: Sniper Killer v1.03
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

One more patch for launch day!
We'll of course continue to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the Steam Discussion Forums or in the Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.


[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes


General Bug Fixes: 

 Fixed issue where Sniper Ammo UI would sometimes incorrectly display all ammo as loaded.
 Fixed issue where players could soft-lock themselves in some levels by killing an NPC at the same moment another NPC was escaped
 Fixed issue where checkpoints would not always properly reset.
 Fixed an issue where the FPS cap did not work. ever. It works now. 


Minor Changes: 

 Decreased intensity of bullet drop in Case 17 (The Bridge)



- Henry and Jordan

notes.title: Sniper Killer v1.02
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We've got our first patch out with some fixes and additions based on early feedback.
We're continuing to keep an eye out for bug reports, please continue to share in the Steam Discussion Forums or in the Black Eyed Priest Discord Server.


[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes


Additions: 

 Added UI text "E" to the Dialogue UI continue arrow. 
 Added UI text "R to Reload" for when the Sniper needs to be reloaded.


General Bug Fixes: 

 Fixed issue causing Case 14 to not unlock in the chapters menu
 Fixed issue causing Case 15 to not unlock in the chapters menu
 Fixed issue causing some audio to not play at the start of Case 21
 Fixed an issue where Sniper Ammo UI would not properly update / refill when restarting a level or progressing to another level while the magazine is partially empty



- Henry and Jordan
